verdict_note: Round 4's own verdict word was FAIL because one minor was left; `passed` in this file is the ledger's token for an audit with no open blocker or major, so the row is recorded clean-with-findings, not clean. The minor is listed under ui.settings.shortcuts and nothing was suppressed.
audit_kind: DELTA audit of exactly the 27 keys this branch adds or changes across ui.settings.shortcuts (13), ui.chat.composer (8: 6 added, 2 changed) and ui.chat.canonical (6), read on the MERGED catalogue bytes. Not a full-file audit and not a human review: every other key of these three files is byte-identical to one of the two independently audited parents (catalogue-union-parity reports no value differences), so their audits stand in the superseded rows.
independence: A different agent and model family from the translators. The 27 keys were translated this wave by i18n-translator anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 (self-reported); this audit ran read-only through the codex MCP with the strings, the English source, the context sidecar, a style-guide excerpt and the shipped vocabulary pasted into the prompt. The coder that assembled this receipt neither translated nor audited.
rounds:
Round 4 is the verdict recorded here: FAIL with 0 blocker/major and 1 minor. Rounds 1-3 each failed on at least one major.

Round 1: 1 major on ui.chat.composer.placeholder.waiting_both, where « file » read as the verb filer and broke the shipped « file d’attente »; minors on ui.settings.shortcuts.action.send_both and ui.chat.composer.steer_hint_both, plus a minor on ui.chat.canonical.send_failure.delivery_unsupported for writing « mode “orientation” » where the actionable mode label is « orienter ».

Round 2: 1 major on ui.chat.composer.placeholder.waiting_both, whose « Échap » omitted the action - the reader was not told the key stops the turn; a minor on ui.settings.shortcuts.action.send_both and a nit on send_failure.delivery_unsupported.

Round 3: 2 majors on ui.chat.composer.steer_hint and steer_hint_steer, which translated the key names Enter and Esc to Entrée and Échap where the context sidecar says “Keep the key names Enter and Esc exactly as written”; a minor on ui.settings.shortcuts.action.send_both and nits on the adjacent action.send_queue and action.send_steer labels (nonbreaking space before the colon, now applied in the convergence edits).

Round 4 kept only the action.send_both minor: « file » alone instead of the shipped mode label « file d’attente ».

THE ENTER/ESC INCONSISTENCY IS DELIBERATE AND IS RECORDED, NOT HIDDEN. steer_hint and steer_hint_steer now keep the English key names Enter and Esc because en/ui.chat.composer.context.json requires them verbatim, while other fr composer strings in the same file still say Entrée and Échap (placeholder.waiting_steer/waiting_queue/waiting_both, steer_hint_queue, steer_hint_both, insert_transcript_hint, stop_work_hint). The sidecar note is authoritative for these two keys, so fr now carries both spellings by design.

ui.chat.canonical was cleared in its own pass first: that pass's round 1 failed on send_failure.delivery_unsupported and its round 2 passed (manager session 2405ebc40b47 scratchpad/audit-fold-canonical.json). The fold2 rounds that followed reported at most a minor and a nit on that key, and round 4 did not reopen it.
